mapper.sql: ITEM_ID, OWNER_KAKAO_ID, ITEM_TYPE, TITLE, TO_CHAR(BASE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS BASE_DATE, HAS_YEAR, COUNT_FROM_ONE, INTERVAL_DAYS, YEARLY, NOTIFY_DAYS, MEMO
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TCAL_ITEM WHERE OWNER_KAKAO_ID = #{ownerId} AND IS_HIDDEN = 0 ORDER BY ITEM_ID
SELECT FROM TCAL_ITEM WHERE IS_HIDDEN = 0 ORDER BY ITEM_ID
SELECT FROM TCAL_ITEM WHERE ITEM_ID = #{itemId} AND IS_HIDDEN = 0
mapper.insert:
SELECT TCAL_ITEM_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TCAL_ITEM ( ITEM_ID, OWNER_KAKAO_ID, ITEM_TYPE, TITLE, BASE_DATE, HAS_YEAR, COUNT_FROM_ONE, INTERVAL_DAYS, YEARLY, NOTIFY_DAYS, MEMO, IS_HIDDEN, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{itemId}, #{ownerKakaoId}, #{itemType}, #{title}, TO_DATE(#{baseDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{hasYear}, #{countFromOne}, #{intervalDays}, #{yearly}, #{notifyDays, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{memo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 0, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE TCAL_ITEM SET ITEM_TYPE = #{itemType}, TITLE = #{title}, BASE_DATE = TO_DATE(#{baseDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), HAS_YEAR = #{hasYear}, COUNT_FROM_ONE = #{countFromOne}, INTERVAL_DAYS = #{intervalDays}, YEARLY = #{yearly}, NOTIFY_DAYS = #{notifyDays, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, MEMO = #{memo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE ITEM_ID = #{itemId} AND OWNER_KAKAO_ID = #{ownerKakaoId} AND IS_HIDDEN = 0
UPDATE TCAL_ITEM SET IS_HIDDEN = 1 WHERE ITEM_ID = #{itemId} AND OWNER_KAKAO_ID = #{ownerId}

MERGE INTO TCAL_NOTIFY_LOG T USING (SELECT #{itemId} AS ITEM_ID, TO_DATE(#{occurDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS OCCUR_DATE, #{daysBefore} AS DAYS_BEFORE FROM DUAL) S ON (T.ITEM_ID = S.ITEM_ID AND T.OCCUR_DATE = S.OCCUR_DATE AND T.DAYS_BEFORE = S.DAYS_BEFORE) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (ITEM_ID, OCCUR_DATE, DAYS_BEFORE, SENT_AT) VALUES (S.ITEM_ID, S.OCCUR_DATE, S.DAYS_BEFORE, SYSDATE)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TCAL_NOTIFY_LOG WHERE ITEM_ID = #{itemId} AND OCCUR_DATE = TO_DATE(#{occurDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND DAYS_BEFORE = #{daysBefore}
